question:
If '÷' means '+', '–' means '×', '×' means '–' and '+' means '÷', then find the value of

40 ÷ 20 × 10 + 10 – 5.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b58774e01647a1dce8585af0b0e3da55f676e12ce10b27c06a6c9935db9f0739.png]

**Given:**

40 ÷ 20 × 10 + 10 – 5

After replacing the signs from left to right and using the BODMAS rule,

40 + 20 – 10 ÷ 10 × 5

= 40 + 20 – 1 × 5

= 40 + 20 – 5

= 60 – 5

= 55

Hence, **“55”** is the correct answer.
